Name: Fitba
Overview:
Fitba is a soccer game which allows players to participate in friendly matches, cup tournaments and leagues. This game's unique selling point is its approach to passing and shooting: instead of pressing buttons, the players directs the ball's direction and speed by using the right analogue stick. The movement direction is controlled independently. When on the defensive, the player can tackle. Another specialty is Fitba's approach to dribbling: how well the athlete controls the ball is shown by its highlight - if it is weak, he will likely lose control soon.

The game is action oriented and loses some real-life rules such as offside or added time. There are three camera perspectives, two difficulty modes and the teams/athletes can be edited.
